units.title: Port truthful progress leases onto current main
units.objective: Distinguish durable advancement from heartbeat and blocker lifecycle events on the current claim/session runtime without changing ownership automatically.

included: Additive ProgressEventV1 fields and owning-session mutation
Stalled classification with bounded quiet intervals
Registry and session status step-down context
Current-main salvage of the useful Plan 70 fixtures
Correction that blocker and handoff events do not renew progress
excluded: Automatic claim release, takeover, rebase or deletion

outputs: ProgressEventV1-compatible claim fields and mutation command
One canonical stalled classifier used by registry and session status
Both-sign current-main tests for heartbeat, blocker, quiet interval, legacy state and pruning

acceptance.criterion: A live claim with fresh heartbeats and expired durable progress is reported stalled with exact evidence and next action while ownership remains unchanged.
evidence_required: Focused claim, registry and session status tests
acceptance.negative_control: Heartbeat, blocker, handoff, file dirt and stalled pruning cannot change progress_at or release the claim.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live registry claim owns only the progress-lease runtime, status, documentation and focused-test paths.

units.title: Implement provider-free blocker and ready-queue decisions
units.objective: Return a typed deterministic disposition that distinguishes ready alternatives, path waits, verified blockers and incomplete queue knowledge without mutating claims.

included: Strict BlockerRequestV1, ReadyQueueEvaluationV1 and BlockerDispositionV1 contracts
Revision-bound work-graph queue evaluation
Claim-conflict and mailbox-delivery evidence inputs
A/B/C and unrelated-root fixtures
Read-only decision CLI
excluded: Work-graph requirement for unplanned light work

outputs: Strict blocker and queue Pydantic contracts
Pure ready-queue and blocker disposition evaluator

acceptance.criterion: The same deterministic evaluator returns continue_ready_work for A blocked/B ready, integration_wait for a path collision, and goal_blocked_verified only for complete queue coverage with no eligible units and a supported blocker.
evidence_required: A/B/C positive and negative fixture receipts
Stale, missing and malformed graph tests
acceptance.negative_control: Partial or unavailable queue coverage and a merely persisted mailbox message cannot produce goal_blocked_verified.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live registry claim owns only the new blocker-policy module, read-only CLI and focused tests.

units.title: Apply blocker dispositions through safe scoped lifecycle operations
units.objective: Record the deterministic disposition and either continue another unit or safely narrow, hand off, or retire only the blocked goal scope while preserving unrelated roots and dirty work.

included: Sanctioned blocker-session entrypoint
Scoped blocker receipt persistence
Scoped handoff or retirement of one goal root and descendants
Installed wrapper generation
End-to-end A/B/C and true-blocker lifecycle tests
excluded: Ending unrelated roots owned by the same runtime

outputs: Sanctioned blocker disposition and scoped lifecycle command
End-to-end receipts for continue-ready-work and true-blocker paths

dependencies.rationale: Lifecycle application must preserve the accepted progress-versus-liveness state model.
Ownership changes may consume only an accepted deterministic disposition.

acceptance.criterion: One installed command denies a whole-goal block while a unit is ready and safely records and retires only the selected goal scope for a verified true blocker.
evidence_required: Idempotent replay and dirty-work preservation tests
acceptance.negative_control: An unrelated authorized root remains active and no dirty worktree, branch or claim is deleted, rebased or taken over.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Both provider units are accepted and one integration claim exclusively owns their shared lifecycle and installer paths.

units.title: Integrate the compact workspace no-passive-waiting instruction
units.objective: Add one compact universal instruction that routes agents to the enforced blocker lifecycle without conflicting with the concurrently implemented ecosystem-feedback instruction.

included: Canonical workspace bootstrap source edit after feedback-lane integration
Generated instruction-surface synchronization
One navigation test showing both compact instructions
excluded: Duplicating detailed blocker policy in every repository
Editing another agent's active branch or claim

outputs: One canonical workspace instruction covering no-passive-waiting

dependencies.rationale: The workspace instruction must point to a real installed lifecycle capability.

acceptance.criterion: The always-loaded workspace instruction tells agents to evaluate ready work before reporting blocked and to record a precise blocker/resume event, while preserving the accepted feedback-routing instruction.
evidence_required: Navigation test for both feedback and blocker routes
acceptance.negative_control: No derived AGENTS.md is hand-edited and neither compact instruction duplicates the other's detailed implementation.

failed_guards: the project-meta universal-feedback bootstrap claim must be integrated or released

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Claim only after the active workspace-bootstrap feedback lane is integrated or released and NPW-03 is accepted.

units.title: Observe stalled-lane usefulness without enabling takeover
units.objective: Classify real stalled reports and determine whether the reporting deadline or instrumentation needs adjustment without changing ownership semantics.

included: Read-only fleet status capture
Classification as genuine stall, legitimate quiet work, missing instrumentation or noisy threshold
Bounded recommendation on reporting configuration
excluded: Changing blocker semantics from an observational sample

dependencies.rationale: Observation is meaningful only after the runtime and compact agent instruction are installed together.

acceptance.criterion: Every observed stalled row steps down to one exact claim and is classified with evidence without mutating any claim or worktree.
acceptance.negative_control: The observation command performs zero claim, branch, worktree or tracker mutations.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: NPW-04 is accepted; claim only the read-only evidence output path.
